metadata.title: Bounce in chip stocks is wiped out by a another big, broad selloff - MarketWatch

content.text:
53 min ago
Bounce in chip stocks is wiped out by a another big, broad selloff
So much for the reversal of the rotation trade, as chip stocks are headed for another broad selloff. The iShares Semiconductor ETF was shedding 4.5% toward a one-month low, with all 30 of its equity components losing ground.
Reasons behind the return to selling include disappointment over Samsung's earnings, even though they beat expectations, and a Reuters report that China's DeepSeek was developing its own chips.
The SOXX ETF had gained 2.7% on Monday, after tumbling 11.6% over the previous two sessions, amid a brief reversal in the rotation trade that saw investors move out of previously hot sectors and into previous laggards.
